message: V_fn takes a snapshot, got V_got
why: A snapshot is the opaque handle returned by memory.checkpoint(): it is a transaction boundary, not a value. Anything else (a json value, an int, a struct) is not a boundary, so committing it would silently do nothing. Snapshot is a separate type rather than json on purpose — it cannot enter json and cannot be passed across a workflow.
fix: pass the value you got from memory.checkpoint()
keep that handle in a local variable between checkpoint() and rollback()/commit() — it is opaque, so it cannot be stored in json or handed to another workflow
